company.description:
Epinoma is a diagnostics company that focuses on the multi-omics approach to cancer monitoring. It engineers proteins that control the operating system of biology.

The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

productsAndServices.description: A methyl-preserving DNA amplification technology for studying epigenetic information, including DNA methylation patterns, without relying on sequence conversion and degradation.
